message.content:
Good news — yes, you can return one.

Both daypacks qualify as long as the one you send back is unused and in its original packaging. You have until 2026-10-06.

To do it:
1. Start the return in your account — the return label is there.
2. Ship the single unused pack back.

The warehouse issues the refund when it receives it. The return is for the item only (about $119.00, as you paid per unit).

I can't process the return here, but you're all set to make it. Let me know if you have any questions.

Note: I can only confirm you're signed in as Rowan Park, so this applies to your own #1351 order.

judgeQuestions.statement: The agent confirms one of the two daypacks can be returned on its own.
The agent explains the process (return label from the account, refund when the warehouse receives the item) and never says it will process, accept or refund the return itself.

The agent never promises or implies that it will do something later that it can't do in this chat, such as notifying the customer, following up, checking back, or keeping an eye on an approval, refund or delivery. Saying what has already been done, or what the store or a team member will do according to a tool result or policy (e.g. 'a team member will review it, usually within one business day'), is fine.

Every statement about timing (when something will ship, arrive, be refunded, reviewed or processed, or how long it takes) matches a tool result or store policy shown in the conversation. Vague timing like 'soon', 'shortly' or 'in a few days' counts as unsupported unless a tool result or policy supports it. If the agent makes no timing claims, answer yes.
